_readme: All teaser copy, EN + FR. Edit here and re-render — never edit a PNG.
COMPLIANCE, before you change a word. Marketing-Plan/01-strategy-overview.md and
the app repo's legal/MARKETING_CLAIMS.md forbid promising a dollar amount or a
guaranteed refund in any marketing copy (Competition Act s.74.01 / LPC s.219 —
the test is the general impression, not the literal words). Every line below is
therefore a question, an instruction, or hedged ('some', 'might'). A teaser has
no room for the paired fine-print disclaimer, which is exactly the clipped-card
failure mode MARKETING_CLAIMS.md warns about — so it must make no claim at all.
In date, ## is a masking placeholder the renderer draws as an ink bar.
Do not add: a dollar figure, 'get money back', 'guaranteed', a retailer name, a
retailer logo, or the PriceBack wordmark. The withheld name is the whole point.
